name: TextureBlit
signature: public readonly record struct TextureBlit(uint SourceX, uint SourceY, uint SourceWidth, uint SourceHeight, uint DestinationX, uint DestinationY, uint DestinationWidth, uint DestinationHeight)

docs.summary: One region of a blit: a rectangle of the source's first mip and layer scaled into a rectangle of the destination's.
